# dcode-harmony — documentation index for LLM agents

> Purpose: let an AI agent locate the right document without scraping.
> Every entry is a repo-relative path plus a one-line description.

## Entry points

- README.md — project summary, quickstart, status, doc links.
- AGENTS.md — mandatory workflow (document → test → implement → granular push).
- HANDOFF.md — current state, decisions, verified APIs, session log.
- MILESTONES.md — roadmap M0–M6 with acceptance criteria.

## docs/ (Diátaxis)

Tutorials:
- docs/tutorials/getting-started.md — clone to working `dcode` in ~10 min.

How-to:
- docs/how-to/install.md — source/editable install.
- docs/how-to/run-llama-server.md — validated server command + health check.
- docs/how-to/configure-profile.md — `DEEPAGENTS_HOME`, bootstrap config.
- docs/how-to/run-tests.md — unit vs live suites, lint/type gates.

Reference:
- docs/reference/architecture.md — components and integration order.
- docs/reference/configuration.md — defaults and overrides.
- docs/reference/dependencies.md — pinned package versions.
- docs/reference/error-contract.md — httpx exception contract table.
- docs/reference/apply-patch.md — grammar and safety guarantees.

Explanation:
- docs/explanation/design-decisions.md — why the current shape exists.
- docs/explanation/live-validation.md — what was/wasn't live-tested.

Index:
- docs/README.md — human-readable map of all of the above.
